title: Palindromes on the $τ$-circle: A note for Palindrome Tau Day, 6/28/26
summary: An integer palindrome is a self-reciprocal polynomial evaluated at its base, so its roots are symmetric about the unit circle -- where the coordinate is angle, in turns of $τ$. Read this way, the date $\texttt{6/28/26}\to 62826$ secretly contains the primitive cube roots of unity -- at angle $τ/3$ -- along with one further pair of roots on the circle.
